summary: This tutorial explains how to perform peer review using LibreOffice Writer's document peer review feature. It starts by opening an existing document and enabling the "Record Changes" option for tracking edits. When changes are made, they are highlighted in a different color, showing who made them and when. Users can insert comments, delete text, or modify content, which appears clearly in the document. The reviewer can accept or reject these changes, and approved edits are included in the final document upon saving. The tutorial demonstrates this process using documents like "sevenreasonstoadoptfoss.odt" and "governmentsupportforfossinindia.odt". It shows how multiple reviewers can edit the same document, with each change highlighted differently. The tutorial also highlights how the system identifies the reviewer based on their username set during LibreOffice installation.
